desc: Prove rigorously that one operation reverses exactly three consecutive gaps and preserves all other gaps.
Show that swaps of positions \(i\) and \(i+2\) generate arbitrary permutations within the odd-indexed and even-indexed gap groups.
Derive the total-coordinate formula \(N X_1+\sum_{j=1}^{N-1}(N-j)g_j\) and apply the rearrangement inequality to determine the optimal ordering.
Implement the independent sorting of odd- and even-indexed gaps and compute the answer using Python integers.
Validate the implementation against the provided samples and relevant edge cases.
